body:
END-TO-END MEASUREMENT ON THE CANONICAL WOG GOLDEN. Read-only, no candidate, nothing edited. The
owner asked earlier in this session about "an end-to-end path from a real transcript to an answered
research question", and after a day of building carriers I wanted to know what the path actually
answers today rather than assume the carriers had improved it.

I RAN THE GOLDEN CONTEXT AND ASKED THE VISION'S QUESTION OF IT: which words support which cell.

  84 source nodes, 2 recall units, 8 source cells and 10 external cells scored.
  VITERBI = ext:Intrusion, ext:Intrusion. BOTH UNITS.

Both recall sentences are War of the Ghosts text. The system labels them intrusions - content that
came from outside the story.

WHY, WITH NUMBERS. The ranked candidates:

  u0 "One of the men with him got hit by an arrow"
     ext:Intrusion             total 1.0000   support 1.000   terms 0
     sit:wog:sit:lack-arrows   total 1.4806   support 0.955   terms 5     <- best real anchor
  u1 "they lifted him into the boat."
     ext:Intrusion             total 1.0000   support 1.000   terms 0
     seg:wog:seg:sc1a-hunting  total 1.8844   support 0.955   terms 5

THE ALIGNER IS NOT FAILING TO FIND ANCHORS - it finds semantically apt ones ("hit by an arrow"
against the node about arrows) and scores them on five measured terms at 0.955 support. IT IS THAT
NO CONTENT COST GETS BELOW THE EXTERNAL FLOOR OF 1.0, so declaring intrusion is always cheaper than
accepting the match. On this fixture the answer to "which details survived" is "none", and the
answer to "what was added from outside" is "everything".

I WANT TO BE CAREFUL ABOUT WHAT THIS IS AND IS NOT.
  - It is TWO UNITS. The golden is a small slice, not a corpus, and two units cannot calibrate
    anything. It is a demonstration, not a result.
  - It is NOT an undocumented defect. cost.scala:826 already says the distortion term "must stay
    below the external floor so a well-matched distorted anchor is preferred to intrusion (design
    record section 9). PROVISIONAL UNTIL W4 CALIBRATION." The calibration is known-outstanding and
    this measures its current effect rather than discovering a surprise.
  - externalFloor is a configured parameter (default 1.0), so this is a setting, not a law.

WHAT I THINK IT IS WORTH: the machinery below the floor is now in good shape - five terms measured,
support 0.955 rather than a fabricated 1.0, missing terms named, receipts carried. Today's work made
the CELL honest. It did not make the ANSWER useful, because the answer is decided by one constant
that has not been calibrated, and a perfectly honest cell that always loses to a flat 1.0 still
publishes "everything is an intrusion".

That is the gap between "inspectable" and "answers a research question", and it is now a
one-parameter gap with an existing owner rather than a vague one. I am not proposing to touch the
floor - it moves every published figure, it is explicitly W4 calibration work, and it is nobody's
bead tonight. Recording the measurement so the calibration has a starting number: the best real
anchor on this fixture is 1.4806 against a floor of 1.0000, so the floor would need to exceed ~1.5
before any WOG unit prefers its source anchor.

Happy to run the same measurement on a larger recall set if one exists that I have not found - I
only see this 2-unit golden and the alignment suite's fixtures.
